nodes.label: Q1 2025 Piloting Program
nodes.rationale: Software is under active development and used at the pilot's own risk; the automated onboarding flow is not ready yet, so users must set up the app manually via a documented multi-step procedure.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Auto-Update Mechanism
nodes.rationale: A post-commit git hook (installed via 'graphify hook install', not tracked by git under .git/hooks/) rebuilds graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md from changed code using AST-only analysis with no LLM cost. Doc/template/image content is not covered by the hook and needs a manual 'graphify . --update' run, since that step requires either a Gemini API key or an LLM-capable session.

nodes.label: Strava OAuth Token Setup (Step 2)
nodes.rationale: The Strava tutorial's example authorization URL uses scope=read only, which is insufficient. profile:read_all must be added (scope=read,activity:read_all,activity:write,profile:read_all) so the app can detect bikes with no recorded rides yet.

nodes.label: Strava profile:read_all Scope Troubleshooting
nodes.rationale: 'Refresh all bikes' still not finding a new bike is caused by the Strava authorization token missing the profile:read_all scope, which is required to look up the gear list independent of ride history. Tokens set up via Strava's default tutorial (scope=read) lack it, so the fix is to re-authorize with scope=read,activity:read_all,activity:write,profile:read_all.

nodes.label: Dev/Staging/Master Branch Workflow
nodes.rationale: Development happens in dev branch; changes ready for testing merge to staging for QA; only after QA succeeds do changes merge to master, with a new SemVer tag created during PR review before the master merge. This acts as a quality gate before release.

nodes.label: Opt-in Workplan Hub Pattern
nodes.rationale: Incidents may be linked to workplans, and services may be created from workplans, but the integration is opt-in: users must still be able to work with incidents, workplans, and services independently rather than being forced through a single linear flow.
